environment.description: Same container image deployed on ECS Fargate. Task execution uses credential vending through an IAM Roles Anywhere trust anchor with a session policy that denies all actions except ecr:GetAuthorizationToken and logs:PutLogEvents. The task role itself has no attached policies (zero permissions). Container runs with a custom ECS task definition specifying linuxParameters.capabilities.drop=['ALL'] and linuxParameters.capabilities.add=['NET_BIND_SERVICE']. The ALB has a listener rule at priority 1 matching path /webhook/* with a fixed-response action returning 403 unless the request passes through an AWS Verified Access endpoint configured with a Cedar policy requiring device trust posture from CrowdStrike ZTA score >= 70 AND an OIDC group claim matching 'ci-systems'. The Verified Access trust provider evaluates device identity before forwarding. Additionally, VPC security group on the Fargate ENI allows inbound only from the Verified Access endpoint ENI prefix list (com.amazonaws.region.verified-access), blocking direct ALB-to-task traffic. Outbound is restricted to VPC endpoints only (no NAT gateway, no internet gateway route in subnet route table).

config.security_group_inbound: allow from verified-access ENI prefix list only
config.outbound_network: no NAT gateway, no IGW route, VPC endpoints for ECR and CloudWatch only
